comment: The assets every engine process of a queue loads after its warm-up and keeps for its life (docs/fast-checks.md, SP-6; UScenarioBatchSubsystem::KeepAssets): a fixed set, the same in every process whatever its jobs. Without it a job's world loaded and built the NPC's meshes anew, about 0.4 s a job. SANDBOX_KEEP_ASSETS=0 runs without it.
